title: My Members » Member Categories » Front & Back End Overview
text:
## My Members » Member Categories » Front & Back End Overview
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000067992
By default, all sites come with a categories page that can be accessed using the / categories URL and through the Footer Menu link on the Homepage:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090914687/original/rrJZcwHECKlWdpi-5cH3rUbOYlFjQIHcxw.png?1617664150 | alt: ]
This will allow the website visitors and members to browse through all of the categories available on the site:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090914703/original/suOYa5xITozd9IW11fNQCXTNZqjioa3fEQ.png?1617664200 | alt: ]
For sites with a lot of categories, the search bar makes it easy for the website users to quickly find what they are looking for, which will search for any matching keywords:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090914733/original/GdItgcrO1_hqs0nTqJgEAyQthw31sCHYbw.png?1617664230 | alt: ]
This page can use two different category widgets.
Bootstrap Theme - Category Groups - Member Categories : will display all Top, Sub and Sub-sub level categories.
Bootstrap Theme - Sub Category Groups - Member Categories : will display all Sub and Sub-sub level categories.
In addition, both widgets support using a URL parameter to pre-fill the keyword filter. This works with spaces, quotation marks, and special characters.
Examples:
https://directory.directoryup.com/ categories?category=Sub%20Sub
https:// directory .directoryup.com/ sub-categories?category=Museum%20of%20zoology

## Sort Order
The order in which the categories are displayed on this page can be changed in the General Settings section under the Search Settings tab of the admin dashboard as seen below

## Advanced Settings
There are a few advanced settings that can help further customize the categories pages.

## Show Categories with No Members
To only display the categories that have been selected by at least one member, make sure to disable this setting under General Settings:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12165010001/original/NA9AgC-OqE9MRSjWW3IfmORnk9zs7SvHww.png?1753749489 | alt: ]

## ⚠️ Important Note - Categories Page URL
Changing the URL of this page will not change all the links throughout the website (like the footer link shown above). If a change is made in the /categories URL, this new URL should be updated under the following Advanced Setting as well:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12165010071/original/8Mf-5-6X_kGQG95tevmSyt9CQfX9p2b3PQ.png?1753749517 | alt: ]
For example , if the web page's URL is changed from /categories to /categories-1 , the advanced setting specified above should be updated to /categories-1 as well.
